title: Don’t Start Infinite Banking Until You Understand THIS
summary: An infinite-banking promoter explains how overfunded whole life policies are designed and pitches borrowing against them as being your own bank.

assertions.quote: every dollar that you used to give away to those credit cards is now making its way back over here

verdicts.note: The recaptured payments are your own savings plus loan interest paid to the insurer; the gain comes from paying off debt or saving, which works without a policy.

assertions.quote: this is the only vehicle that allows me to take money out and not interrupt that guaranteed interest and the dividends

verdicts.note: Policy loans leave cash value in place earning credits, but the loan accrues interest and some insurers cut dividends on borrowed sums, so the net gain is only the spread.

assertions.quote: if you're earning six and you're paying four you're making a spread and each year your spread goes up

verdicts.note: The dividend rate is not the policy's net return after insurance costs; long-run cash-value returns are a few percent and loan rates are often similar, so the spread is small or negative.

assertions.quote: what is the return on your 10 000 that you deposited that year isn't it more than 30 percent

verdicts.note: This counts growth on all prior premiums as a return on one year's deposit; measured properly, whole life cash value compounds at low single digits.

assertions.quote: it's tax free it's liquid it is guaranteed

verdicts.note: Growth is tax-deferred and loans untaxed if the policy stays in force and avoids MEC status, but only a low base rate is guaranteed, dividends are not, and early surrender loses money.

assertions.quote: so they could make on a 10 000 premium 5 500 or almost 10 000

verdicts.note: First-year whole life commissions commonly run from half to all of the base premium, and early cash values sit far below premiums paid.

assertions.quote: that's the money that becomes available to you immediately and that's the money you can use

verdicts.note: Paid-up-addition riders carry low commissions and add cash value quickly, which is why high-cash-value designs use them within IRS MEC limits.

assertions.quote: you still got to use the money to make the equivalent of 20 by recycling and recapturing the money you were giving away
